description:
The first plot, titled "Easy Training Set," illustrates the training rewards over a series of steps for two different methods: "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." The x-axis, labeled "Steps," ranges from 0 to 500 and is linear, indicating the progression of steps in the training process. The y-axis, labeled "Training Rewards," ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 and is also linear, representing the rewards obtained during training. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line is blue with a solid line style, while the "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line is red with a solid line style. Both lines show an upward trend, with the "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line generally above the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line, indicating higher training rewards. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line starts at approximately 0.1 and ends around 0.35, while the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line starts at approximately 0.05 and ends around 0.3. The plot shows some fluctuations, with both lines experiencing peaks and declines, but overall, they follow a similar trend.

The second plot, titled "Hard Training Set," also shows the training rewards over a series of steps for the same two methods. The x-axis is the same as the first plot, ranging from 0 to 500 steps, and the y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 0.2, indicating the rewards obtained during training. The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line is blue with a solid line style, and the "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line is red with a solid line style. Both lines show an upward trend, with the "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line generally above the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line, indicating higher training rewards. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line starts at approximately 0.05 and ends around 0.15, while the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line starts at approximately 0.0 and ends around 0.1. The plot shows more pronounced fluctuations, with both lines experiencing more significant peaks and declines, but overall, they follow a similar trend.
